context.content:
Hello!

Right now I have my MBP 13" in a stand and it is connected to an external keyboard, mouse and monitor and power, thus using all my 4 USB ports, which is always an hassle either to setup or when I actually need to connect some other device.

I had an unpowered switch hub with my keyboard and my mouse, but the keyboard would sometimes lose power (I noticed the RGB shutting down for a few milliseconds then coming back) so I think the best would be to get a powered USB hub.

I'm fine with leaving only one USB port open, but the best would be to be able to connect the mouse, screen and monitor to a single USB port. And then I could also charge my laptop directly with its own charger for more wattage.

Does anyone recommend a good USB hub that can achieve this? Every time I google, it's always someone complaining about a certain hub that does not work as expected.

Thank you!! And good weekend!
